decisions.reason: After only about a year, demand and mission adoption are still highly uncertain, and a dedicated product page suggests enough commitment that keeping this option open is more valuable than exiting now.
Its modular design broadens possible applications in a long-cycle space market, so a large German high-tech firm would likely continue to hold this option while uncertainty resolves.
A dedicated space situational awareness offering fits a specialized market with slow qualification and procurement cycles, making early abandonment unlikely absent clear negative signals.

Because it was only mentioned rather than fully presented, this product has a weaker commercial signal and higher exit risk, but the firm would still likely keep it for now given low carrying cost and unresolved uncertainty.
